operations.source_name: HM Land Registry National Polygon dataset technical specification
operations.details_summary: Official technical specification identifies the National Polygon Dataset as HMLR Index Polygons for England and Wales and documents their indexing purpose.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry National Polygon dataset technical specification
operations.details_summary: Index polygons indicate the location of a registered title; they are not silently treated as exact legal boundaries. Title plan/register semantics remain authoritative unless a boundary has been formally determined.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry National Polygon dataset technical specification
operations.details_summary: HMLR documents index polygon capture in British National Grid, supporting the existing EPSG:27700 geometry workflow without coordinate inference.

operations.source_name: Defra Data Services Platform WCS service update
operations.details_summary: Official service notice documents the replacement of legacy image services with open WCS/WMS services and a persistent no-year-suffix LIDAR Composite endpoint.

operations.source_name: Defra Data Services Platform WCS service update
operations.details_summary: EA states WCS can return raw pixel data such as elevation; this supports raster-value sampling rather than display-image interpretation.

operations.source_name: Defra Data Services Platform WCS service update
operations.details_summary: A persistent service endpoint is treated as an access contract only; raster byte identity still requires SHA-bound downloads and survey lineage, so no silent substitution occurs.
EA documents that where repeat surveys exist the newest, best-resolution data is used; metadata catalogues remain necessary to identify the survey actually contributing at a location.
EA states resampled composite data uses bilinear interpolation; this is disclosed as source-production methodology and not re-applied silently to parcel results.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
operations.details_summary: HMLR states the dataset updates on the first Sunday monthly and represents the previous month; recency is recorded without inferring exact title-change dates from publication date.
